messages:
elaine: quick async standup — api gateway / routing / auth / rl
what I did: landed a guard in the route policy parser to reject missing `match` fields, pushed a small hotfix to canary. also bumped canary->beta traffic to 20%.
blockers: seeing intermittent 429s in staging when we hit short bursts, not sure if it's token-bucket config or client spike. unable to reproduce locally.
today: pair with @sam on the auth token rotation test, open PR for more granular rate metrics + alerting.

sam: ok, re: 429s — can you drop the staging log snippet here? i want to confirm if it's rl or auth failing first.

elaine: pasted logs from the incident window:
```
2026-03-17T22:15:03Z gw-staging-03 INFO  request_id=abc123 route=ingress-web token_bucket=exhausted burst=1600 limit=1200
2026-03-17T22:15:04Z gw-staging-03 WARN  auth: token-refresh-failed user_id=uid_987 err=timeout
```

kevin: thanks. that looks like a twofold thing — burst > limit plus a few refresh timeouts. i can add short smoothing (50ms jitter) in the thin-client lib this afternoon. should help spread bursts.

tj: fyi i deployed a quick metric for per-route token refill rate in staging so we can graph it. dashboard link: https://grafana.internal/redwood/gw-rate-playback (perm: eng-platform).

sam: i'll start a repro harness that simulates 2k small clients with randomized token refreshes. will post results in this thread.

release-bot: canary->beta bump recorded by release-bot. rollout_id=rb-2026-03-17-78 status=partial (20%) :shipit:

elaine: small note — the policy parser fix required a schema bump. opened CHANGES.md entry and pinged docs for a quick snippet.

kevin: PR thumbs? #4521 has smoothing + comments. quick review appreciated, should be tiny.

sam: ack, i'll review after i get the repro running. if we see auth timeouts correlate, i'll sync with infra to check KMS latency in that window.

elaine: blocker update later today: if repro shows auth timeouts, we might roll back the beta bump until fix is in. otherwise continue with canary expansion tomorrow. :+1:

tj: noted. i'll wire an alert on 5xx spike + token-refill-drop so oncall gets paged before it gets noisy.

kevin: thanks team — pairing at 3pm PT? @sam @elaine

sam: yep 3pm works for me. I'll leave the repro running before then.

elaine: thanks all — i'll update here after pairing and post any followups.
